name: PT Madusari Murni Indah Tbk
summary: PT Madusari Murni Indah Tbk, through its subsidiaries, engages in the production, distribution, trading, advisory, and brokering of various organic and non-organic chemical and non-chemical products in Indonesia. The company operates through Ethanol and Fertilizer; and Carbon Dioxide and Others segments. It provides ethanol, fertilizers, and liquid and dry carbon dioxide (CO2) under the Molindo Ethanol, Molindo CO2, and Molindo Fertilizer brands. The company also engages in the trading of other products, such as adhesives, stretch films, and other products.
